AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: AWS IAM access key with securityagent:List* / Get* permission. Sent via SigV4-signed headers.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: AWS IAM secret key paired with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.

AWS_SESSION_TOKEN.description: STS session token when using AssumeRole credentials. Omit for long-lived IAM users.

AWS_REGION.description: AWS region hosting the Security Agent service. Default 'us-east-1'.

AWS_SECURITY_AGENT_HOST.description: Full API host override. Default 'securityagent.<region>.amazonaws.com'. Override when AWS ships GA under a different endpoint.

AWS_SECURITY_AGENT_FINDINGS_PATH.description: Path (with leading slash) for the findings endpoint. Default '/findings'. Override if AWS Security Agent's API path differs at your account's rollout.

AWS_SECURITY_AGENT_AGENTS_PATH.description: Path for the agent-inventory endpoint. Default '/agents'.

AWS_SECURITY_AGENT_MODE.description: Comma-separated list of what to import. Default 'findings'. Valid: findings (agent-discovered vulns -> vulns), agents (deployed agents -> hosts).

AWS_SECURITY_AGENT_MAX_PAGES.description: Hard cap on pages fetched per mode. Default 50 (= 5k rows at the default page size).

AWS_SECURITY_AGENT_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Client-side severity floor for findings. Valid: info | low | medium | high | critical. Default 'medium'.

name: aws_security_agent
title: AWS Security Agent
description: AWS Security Agent findings import. IAM key + secret signed via SigV4 (no boto3 dependency), walks the Security Agent HTTP API (default securityagent.<region>.amazonaws.com/findings + /agents). Modes: findings (agent-discovered vulns become Faraday vulns tagged '[AGENT]' on the affected AWS resource, with Remediation + Types folded into the description and resource ARNs as refs), agents (registered Security Agents become Faraday hosts tagged 'agent:aws-security-agent:agent-inventory'). AWS severity is normalised into Faraday's info/low/medium/high/critical scheme; MIN_SEVERITY drops rows below the floor. Endpoint host + paths are configurable per install because AWS Security Agent was still in preview at write time. External IDs are stable so re-runs are idempotent. NextToken pagination; backs off 30s on HTTP 429.
